items.html: And then, at the time of birth, the blood returns to ascend, namely the square of the Eheyeh of Hehin that is in the GAT, above their place, as stated in this chapter, that the lights of her NHY ascend upward until opposite the chest; and then it is turned from blood, which is judgment, because the Eheyeh of Hehin is more of judgments, for being in Hehin and for being lower. And there above it is turned into mercy and becomes milk. And behold, it has been explained here how from the drop of redness in the female the blood is made in the offspring; for the blood becomes milk, and after the offspring sucks it, it is turned within him into blood again as at first, except that now it is refined and clear.
